extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single logical SoA table printed as two horizontally tiled column blocks on document pages 53 (VISIT 1-8) and 54 (VISIT 9-13, ET, RT); the second block repeats every body row of the first, so the tiles were merged by activity name and the union of marks taken (prompt v3.7.2 SS5). Two leading label columns (L=2): the activity-name column and the narrow column carrying the 'VISIT'/'WEEK' row labels, so the first data column is position 3. Tile A occupies data positions 3-10, tile B positions 11-17. Position 8 is a genuine rule-bounded column on page 53 that carries no VISIT value, no WEEK value and no marks in any row; it is retained so that VISIT 7 and VISIT 8 keep their printed positions. Mark matrix derived mechanically by pdftotext -bbox column-binning against header-anchored column centres and raster-recovered rule lines, then diffed cell-for-cell against a visual read of both rendered pages with no disagreements.

table_metadata.table_title: Schedule of Events for Protocol H2Q-MC-LZZT(c)
table_metadata.table_purpose: Primary schedule of events for protocol H2Q-MC-LZZT(c): all study activities against visits 1-13 plus Early Termination and Retrieval encounters.
table_metadata.notes: Classified main_soa: the rows are procedures performed on subjects and this is the protocol's only, and therefore anchor, activity x timepoint grid. NOT continuation: page 54 does not continue the row list, it repeats all 28 printed body rows under a different set of visit columns, which is the horizontally tiled wide-table pattern (SS5) - one logical table, two column-block tiles. Page 54 is headed '(concluded)'. The three text lines 'Study drug record' / 'Medications dispensed' / 'Medications returned' sit inside ONE rule-bounded row band with no internal horizontal rule; they are transcribed as three separate activities (rows 24-26) because they are three distinct procedure names, and the printed X marks, which are aligned only with the 'Study drug record' line, are recorded on row 24 only. See the uncertainty report.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Visit identifiers running across the two horizontally tiled column blocks: numbered visits 1-5, an unlabelled column, 7-13, then the named encounters ET (Early Termination) and RT (Retrieval). Classified 'visit' because the values are visit identifiers, not days or weeks. The label 'VISIT' is printed in the narrow second label column.

Study week for each visit column (-2, -.3, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 26). Classified 'week' because the values are week numbers relative to randomization at Week 0. The ET and RT columns carry no week value; the unlabelled column (position 8) carries none either. Label 'WEEK' printed in the narrow second label column, on the same printed row as the activity-column heading 'ACTIVITY'.
